Replies.Text:
Build log: Step 5.2, The Personal check. Built by Claude Fable 5.1 (Claude-CLI) on 2026-10-30. Nothing is committed.

What was built, by item:

1. The gate in the page (public/js/session.js): check_tier() runs once ClerkJS has started in the Desktop (Edition desktop): signed in below Personal (the session's plan, Plan(), the higher of the person's own license and their active organization's), the session keeps the refusal { Error: "license", Plan: "personal" }, the shape a Server's 401 "license" has, and the new Admitted() answers false; elsewhere Admitted() is true (a Server's refusal is its own root's). The sign-in box shows the refusal as it did a Server's: the license message, the link to the licenses and Sign out, no form, no close (the Desktop's sign-in is Required). The message has a Desktop wording in sign-in-box.html: "This account has no Consensus-AI Personal license, which the Desktop needs. Consensus Client opens one project of a Server at a time with any account." Sign out clears the app's current user (ClearLicense) and reloads, as before.
2. Nothing loads below Personal: app.js's DesktopSignedOut (the layout hidden, no route) is Session.Admitted() now rather than SignedIn(); in the Desktop the first root's identity is read and every root's stream listened to only once the session is loaded and the person admitted (listen_all after Session.Ready), where before the streams started at once; the LLM connections' read at start (public/js/llm.js) waits the same way; the Servers popup opens by itself (client-servers.js) and the Servers… menu item shows (title-bar.js) only for a person admitted. In a browser, the Client, the Server's window and the Sidecar nothing changes: Admitted() is true and the reads at start are as they were.
3. The sign-in handed to the app: desktop/preload.js gives SetLicense( Token ) and ClearLicense(), as the Client's and the Server's bridges do; desktop/main.js takes electron/CurrentUser.js (USER over the config folder) and answers set-license by verifying the token and writing <config>/user.json whole (the tier answered, or the tier with an Error and the user unchanged) and clear-license by removing it. session.js already sent the token to any bridge with SetLicense at every load while signed in, so the Desktop now does what the Client does, and the Server application on the same machine sees the sign-in. The Desktop reads that file for nothing: its boot hands License null and main.js calls neither USER.Tier nor USER.Read; the gate is the session's plan.
4. session.js takes a ClerkJS already on the page (window.Clerk set before the page loads) as it is, instead of loading the script: the browser test's and the smoke's stand-in. Nothing else sets window.Clerk.
5. The smoke and the docs pictures (bin/smoke.js, bin/docs.js): the stand-in for the Desktop's sign-in was an override of Session.SignedIn after the load, which the gate on the plan and the reads at start (both at the session's load) make useless; both scripts now install a ClerkJS stand-in before the page loads (Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument, then a reload: stand_in_sign_in( page, plan )), with a null token so no call carries one and nothing reaches SetLicense. The smoke's Desktop part checks the window has SetLicense and License null, then a stand-in with no license (the license message with "which the Desktop needs", Sign out, the page hidden, no root read), then at Personal (the page, every root read) before the checks it had. Not run: it needs Electron with a screen and the owner's word. The docs' Desktop picture is taken at Personal; the pictures were not regenerated (the Desktop picture shows the same page).
6. The docs: docs/guide/getting-started.md (Signing in: a Personal license is needed, below it the box says so with the link and Sign out and nothing else opens; the sign-in is also written as this machine's signed-in person for a Server on it), docs/guide/features.md (the tiers line: the Client any sign-in, the Desktop checking the plan at its sign-in; it already said the Desktop's minimum is Personal and the Client's Registered since Step 5.1), the guide pages rebuilt (node bin/docs.js build, 14 pages, no problem); readme.md (the editions paragraph and the license paragraph: checked at the sign-in in the page, on the session's plan, the current user written for the Server beside it and read for nothing); .guides/run-the-smoke.md (the Desktop's signed-out and Personal check items).

Files: public/js/session.js, public/js/app.js, public/js/llm.js, public/components/sign-in-box/sign-in-box.html, sign-in-box.js (header), public/components/client-servers/client-servers.js, public/components/title-bar/title-bar.js, desktop/main.js, desktop/preload.js, bin/smoke.js, bin/docs.js, docs/guide/getting-started.md and .html, docs/guide/features.md and .html, readme.md, .guides/run-the-smoke.md, test/Desktop.test.js, test/Ui.test.js.

How it was checked:

- test/Ui.test.js, new test "the Desktop's Personal check": the page opened as the Desktop's window with a stand-in bridge (Edition desktop, one Server as a root, Clerk configured, Servers, AddServer, SetLicense recording the token) and a stand-in ClerkJS with a signed-in user. With no license: Tier registered, Admitted false, the refusal license/personal; the box shows the Desktop message, Sign out, no form and no close; the layout is hidden; no Servers popup; no request to any /servers/ address and the root not loaded; the token went to SetLicense. At Personal: Tier personal, no refusal, no box, the layout shown, the root read (a request to /servers/srv/api), the token to SetLicense. The stand-in's remembered sign-in is removed from the page's storage after, since the main page shares the origin.
- test/Desktop.test.js: the app's files test now requires CurrentUser.js in desktop/main.js, USER over config_folder, the set-license handler on USER.SetLicense( Token, {} ) and clear-license on USER.Clear(), the boot's License null and no USER.Tier or USER.Read; the bridge has SetLicense and ClearLicense and License null; the page test asserts check_tier and Admitted in session.js, DesktopSignedOut on Admitted, the reads at start gated in app.js and llm.js, the Servers popup and menu item on Admitted, and the Desktop message in sign-in-box.html.
- The whole suite: 328 tests, 325 pass, 2 skipped (the Clerk keys), 1 failed: test/Docs.test.js, the screenshot script over a copy of docs/, where the Desktop stand-in in bin/docs.js named INJECTOR, a local of desktop_pictures there (fixed: the stand-in names the injector itself); after the fix the Docs test passes alone (2 of 2, the Desktop picture made at Personal) and the Desktop test passes (9 of 9). Neither known load flake showed this run.

Decided during the build: the gate is the session's state (Refusal and Admitted) rather than a new flag, so the sign-in box shows it with the code it has for a Server's license refusal; the reads at start are gated in app.js and llm.js (where they are started) rather than by hiding the layout with ng-if, which would re-create the page's components after the sign-in is known; a ClerkJS stand-in before the load replaces the SignedIn override in the smoke and the docs script, and session.js takes a window.Clerk already present for it; the Desktop's boot and bridge keep License null (nothing in the Desktop reads the machine's current user, as the plan says). The docs pictures were not regenerated: the Desktop's picture is the same page at Personal.

Resolve to accept: I apply this thread, commit as "Review 2026-10-29 Step 5.2: The Personal check", set the subplan Finished and bring the Readme up to date. Reply to send it back.
